newsitem.title: ESTONIA: DIRECTIONLESS TRADE PREVAILS WITH STOCKS MIXED.
newsitem.headline: DIRECTIONLESS TRADE PREVAILS WITH STOCKS MIXED.

text.p: The Estonian bourse was
directionless again on Monday and a small sale of Hansapank
stock helped ease the index lower, dealers said.
Trade volume on the main list at 0815GMT was 6.1 million
kroons with the Talse online index 0.30 percent lower at
"It is directionless at present and there is no change in
sight," one dealer said.
"There was some small sale of Hansapank stock this morning,
but nothing significant," he added.
Hansapank was slightly lower at 128.60/129.25 kroons vs
129.86 kroons with a volume of 2.3 million kroons.
The free market turned over 1.3 million kroons with the
newly listed EVPs or privatistion vouchers the most active with
654,057 kroons traded with a spread of 29.10/29.70 kroons.
"The bourse listing may give some idea of the real price,
but those that are traded are only those registered in the
central depository of securities, so not all are shown as we
keep two quotes," one dealer said.
EVPs are securities given as compensation for property
nationalised by the Soviet regime and also for the number of
years a person worked.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn Newsroom, +372 630 8400,
reuters@reuters.ee
